title: Shish Tawook (Grilled Chicken Skewers)
description: Shish Tawook is a classic Arabic grilled chicken skewer dish made with tender chicken marinated in yogurt, lemon, garlic, and warm spices, then grilled until juicy and lightly charred. It is commonly served with garlic sauce, pita bread, and pickles.

ingredients.title: For the Chicken
items: 1 kg boneless, skinless chicken breasts or thighs, cut into 1.5-inch cubes
Wooden or metal skewers (soaked if wooden)

ingredients.title: For the Marinade
items: ½ tsp chili powder or Aleppo pepper
1 tbsp tomato paste or red bell pepper paste (optional)

instruction.title: Instructions
steps:
1. Prepare the Chicken:
• Cut chicken into uniform cubes.
• Pat dry to help marinade adhere.

2. Make the Marinade:
• Whisk yogurt, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, spices, and optional paste until smooth.
• Adjust seasoning to taste.

3. Marinate the Chicken:
• Coat chicken thoroughly in marinade.
• Refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight for best flavor.

4. Prepare Skewers:
• Thread chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving slight gaps for even cooking.

5. Cook the Chicken:
Grill Method:
• Grill over medium-high heat for 10–12 minutes, turning until charred and cooked through.

Oven Method:
• Bake at 220°C (425°F) for 15–20 minutes, turning halfway.
• Optional broil for extra char.

6. Serve:
• Garnish with parsley and lemon wedges.
• Serve hot with garlic sauce, pickles, pita bread, or rice.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve with garlic toum or tahini sauce
Pair with fattoush or tabbouleh salad
Enjoy with warm pita or saffron rice
Add pickles and grilled vegetables for balance

chefTips: Use chicken thighs for juicier results, or mix with breast meat.
Marinate overnight for deeper flavor infusion.
Leave small gaps on skewers for even heat circulation.
Brush lightly with oil before grilling to prevent sticking.
Finish with sumac or smoked paprika for restaurant-style aroma.
